name: Sengoku no Kuroyuri ~Futanari Hime to Shinobu Shoujo-tachi~
original_name: 戦国の黒百合 ～ふたなり姫と忍ぶ少女達～
source:
An age of war. A princess turned d*ck chick by a suspicious drug.
Unable to resist her incessant ever burning carnal desires, 
she violates girls left, right and center. Losing herself in the process...
Protected by her loyal ninja guards she makes her way to a new land.
Where she meets another girl, with a body like her own.
How will the ninja girls act in response to the startling discoveries!?

一个战争时代。一位公主因可疑药物而变成了小鸡。
无法抗拒不断燃烧的肉欲，
她侵犯了女孩的左、右、中。在这个过程中迷失了自己……

在那里她遇到了另一个与她身体相似的女孩。
面对这些惊人的发现，忍者女孩们将如何行动！？
